queries.compiledQueryString:
select distinct value as concept_value, value as concept_label
from usajobs.AGGR_USAJobsEntityConceptProfile
where category = 'education'
order by case value
  when 'Bachelors' then 1
  when 'Doctorate' then 2
  when 'Masters' then 3
  when 'Associates' then 4
  else 9
end, value

queries.compiledQueryString:
select
  entity_id as occ8,
  entity_label as occupation,
  subcategory,
  value as education,
  postings,
  pct_postings,
  concept_rca
from usajobs.AGGR_USAJobsEntityConceptProfile
where entity_type = 'occupation'
  and category = 'education'
  and value = '${inputs.education_concept.value}'
order by pct_postings desc, concept_rca desc, postings desc
limit 25
